where: crates/blaze-front-items (a new crate written by a write-only lane)
what: I wrote the new crate's Cargo.toml several tool calls before its src/lib.rs. `crates/*` makes every directory with a manifest a workspace member, so cargo could not load the workspace (`can't find library blaze_front_items`) and every other lane's compile and test was blocked until the main agent noticed and told me.
cost: every lane's builds blocked for the minutes between the manifest and the lib
cause: a glob workspace member list makes a half-written crate a whole-workspace failure, and a write-only lane cannot see that it broke the load
class: a partial write that is visible to everyone (save points that do not compile, rule 24)
prevention: a new crate's manifest and its lib.rs are written in the same step, and a module is declared in lib.rs only once its file exists; a gate check could refuse a `crates/*/Cargo.toml` with no `src/lib.rs` or `src/main.rs` before any lane's build runs
workaround: write lib.rs first, with no modules, then the manifest
fix: none in the tree yet (the rule is in the lane brief)
